name: Sudden Clipedge
description: Seats the hilt deep in the palm and drops a short chop so the blade's own weight does the cutting.

name: Cleftblow
description: Releases the wrist at the top of the lift so the falchion's weighted end falls onto the opponent's shoulder.

name: Narrow Nubtip
description: Pulls the curved belly of the edge slowly along the opponent's hip, cutting by the drag rather than the fall.

name: Angled Chopblade
description: Rests the blunt spine on the forearm so the broad blade stands across the body against a straight cut.

name: Chunkpace
description: Slides the back foot a hand's breadth behind the front so the heavy blade recovers without a stumble.

name: Cleaverbelly Stay
description: Shrugs the shoulder to lift the fallen blade back to ready, turning a quick follow-up blow aside with the flat.

name: Flat Hash
description: Raises the falchion over the shoulder and drops it straight down, the way a woodcutter splits a standing log.

name: Heavy Weightbelly
description: Cuts diagonally from collar to hip, letting the swell of the blade carry the stroke through the target.

name: Hew Blow
description: Brings the blade up from a low guard in a curve so the belly of the edge catches the opponent beneath the arm.

name: Descending Cleft
description: Repeats three chops in an even rhythm against a standing post, keeping the wrist loose between each fall.

name: Hashamble
description: Steps off the line of the opponent's answering cut the moment the chop lands.

name: Nubtiphusk
description: Knocks an incoming weapon aside with the broad flat instead of meeting it on the sharpened edge.

name: Heavyback Pause
description: Lets the point sink after a chop, then lifts it in a rising half-circle to cover the chest.

name: Low Wedgetip
description: Turns the sharpened edge squarely into the cut so the heavy blade bites straight instead of skidding away.

name: Thickspine Pause
description: Braces the blunt back of the blade with the free palm to hold off a downward blow.

name: Hard Whack
description: Hacks at a fixed target on a slow, even count to build the arm for the falchion's weight.

name: Falchhilt Drop
description: Snaps the wrist at the end of the swing so the forward weight lands its full force.

name: Hewamble
description: Steps back with the edge tucked under the forearm so the heavy blade never catches on the withdrawal.

name: Stumpcowl
description: Plants the feet wider than the shoulders so a heavy cut can fall without dragging the body forward.

name: Light Chunk
description: Advances by rolling each heel through to the toe, keeping the falchion level throughout the approach.

name: Cleftbump
description: Crosses the rear foot over the front to add the body's turn to a chop from the side.

name: Stiff Nubtip
description: Pivots on the lead foot and lets the blade fall with the hips, landing a hack from the flank.

name: Chunkskitter
description: Shifts the weight onto the rear leg and draws the falchion back out of the opponent's reach.

name: Blunt Hew
description: Drops into a squat and hacks at the opponent's shin while the opponent's guard is held high.

name: Hooding Wedgetip
description: Plants the lead foot and angles the broad blade upward to turn a descending cut away from the head.

name: Cleaverbelly Amble
description: Walks a ring around a standing post, changing the leading foot with every chop to keep the footing even.

name: Leaden Clipedge
description: Draws the curved back of the blade downward so the belly slices through the target in one pull.

name: Leaden Hack
description: Turns the hip into a falling hack that lands on the opponent's near side before the guard comes round.

name: Low Bulkblade
description: Returns the blade upward along the same curve, cutting toward the jaw as the opponent's arm lifts.

name: Wide Chunk
description: Lands the swollen part of the blade on the opponent's wrist, using the added weight to knock the grip loose.

name: Resting Bulkblade
description: Carries the spine over the shoulder so the blade hangs ready and covers the neck while the feet advance.

name: Hewdodge
description: Follows a chop with a sliding step backward, keeping the curved edge between oneself and the opponent.

name: Nubtippause
description: Holds the blade angled overhead with the point down so falling cuts slide off the flat and miss the head.

name: Nubtipcowl
description: Hangs the blade point-down beside the knee to cover the legs against a low sweep.

name: Hooding Heavyback
description: Slaps the flat of the falchion against the opponent's blade and pushes it wide.

name: Settled Falchhilt
description: Turns the forearm under the guarding blade so a glancing cut rolls along the back of the sword.

name: Downward Cleft
description: Releases the hanging guard straight into a downward chop the instant the opponent's cut is turned.

name: Quiet Hack
description: Takes a half-step sideways behind the hanging guard to put the opponent's cut onto empty air.

name: Stumpstay
description: Pins the opponent's elbow against the ribs with the pommel hand, holding the arm still while the blade stays clear.

name: Hashbump
description: Runs a thread of qi down the edge in the instant before a chop lands, sharpening the bite of the heavy blade.

name: Raised Weightbelly
description: Seats a steady stream of qi along the spine so the blade holds firm against a blow from above.

name: Wide Thickspine
description: Times a short exhale with the falling hack so qi and the blade's weight arrive on the target together.

name: Nubpause
description: Warms the wrist with qi and knocks a thrust aside with the broad flat of the blade.

name: Swaying Whack
description: Slides the lead heel forward on a pulse of qi in the legs to shorten the gap for a chop.

name: Whackstrike
description: Feeds qi steadily along the belly of the edge while dragging it across the opponent's guarding arm.

name: Sudden Chopblade
description: Pulses qi into the blade at the top of the lift so the overhead chop arrives heavier than the steel alone.

name: Nubdash
description: Holds the qi until the last finger's width of the hack, then releases it into the point of impact.

name: Hewstrike
description: Times a flat side cut so the swell of the blade meets the target as the qi pulse peaks.

name: Stumpwedge
description: Stills the qi to a low hum in the blade so a hanging guard stays steady through repeated blows.

name: Narrow Cleaverbelly
description: Lets the blade rebound off a blocked cut and pulses qi to turn the rebound into a fresh chop.

name: Skipping Thickspine
description: Shuffles the feet a short pace on a pulse of qi to place the next chop within reach.

name: Resting Weightbelly
description: Parries with the blade's heavy forward section and pulses qi so the opponent's weapon is thrown off line.

name: Whack Drop
description: Rolls the wrist in a figure-eight so the falchion's weight keeps swinging through a chain of cuts.

name: Short Nubtip
description: Rolls the blade over the shoulder and down in one arc, the qi following the wrist's turn.

name: Hashstrike
description: Rolls the wrist underhand so the belly climbs the opponent's leading arm toward the elbow.

name: Ready Chopblade
description: Rolls the blade across the front of the body with qi in the wrist to catch two quick cuts in sequence.

name: Pushing Hash
description: Taps the opponent's sword hand with the rolling swing of the swell, loosening the grip without a full cut.

name: Wedgetip Pace
description: Rotates on the heel of the lead foot in time with the wrist so the next cut comes from a new angle.

name: Planted Bulkblade
description: Passes the blade through two rolling parries without stopping, keeping the opponent's weapon pushed wide.

name: Short Clipedge
description: Rolls out of a parry and clips the opponent's wrist with the sharpened forward edge before the arm retracts.

name: Stiff Hack
description: Extends the arm to full reach as the blade drops, so the forward weight lands at the very end of the stroke.

name: Light Falchhilt
description: Slides the rear foot forward behind a lunging chop to lengthen the falchion's reach by a stride.

name: Swaying Heavyback
description: Drags the lead heel back along the ground after a chop to restore the stance before the answering strike.

name: Kept Nubtip
description: Lifts the fallen blade smoothly to a covering guard, using qi in the forearm to take its weight.

name: Settled Wedgetip
description: Stretches the arm out and parries with the broad flat to keep a thrust at the full length of the falchion.

name: Sharp Whack
description: Brings the belly of the blade down through the target with qi along the edge for a deep cleave.

name: Cleftstrike
description: Cuts upward on a slant, carrying qi from hip to shoulder so the cleave follows the rising line.

name: Hewhit
description: Draws a slow breath as the blade returns, steadying the arm for the next cleave.

name: Solid Cleaverbelly
description: Gathers qi along the spine and holds the falchion upright across the chest against a heavy overhead strike.

name: Stepping Hack
description: Steps sideways out of the opponent's counter as the cleave finishes, leaving the empty air in front.

name: Solid Bulkblade
description: Raps the swollen section of the blade against an incoming thrust and throws it aside with a pulse of qi.
